title: Angleton-signed CIA wiretap of Marilyn Monroe, 1962

tellings.quote: That's a basic, it's in the do briefing document. It's a wiretap of Marilyn Monroe in ' 62, a couple days before they killed her, threatening to hold a press conference.

plain: The CIA supposedly wiretapped Marilyn Monroe in 1962 and recorded her threatening to hold a press conference "a couple days before they killed her", in a document signed by James Jesus Angleton, the CIA's counterintelligence chief at the time. Steven Greer, a UFO activist who campaigns for government disclosure, tells Michels this and says the wiretap is part of the briefing document he hands out. If true, it would mean the CIA was watching Monroe and her death was no accident.
